words.definition: a quotation or mention, often of another person's work
words.example: The poem contains an allusion to a famous Greek myth that many readers recognize.
words.zh: 引用或提及，通常是他人的作品

words.example: The action of light waves is analogous to the action of sound waves.

words.definition: to make something happen by necessity or force
words.example: The representatives were compelled to vote in favor of the legislation despite their personal opposition to it.
words.zh: 因必要或強製而使某事發生

words.example: The film club asked each of its members to compile a list of his or her favorite movies.
Their formidable opponents gave no sign of weakness.

words.definition: the state of being inside when not desired to be there by others
words.example: The intrusive bacteria caused his condition to worsen.
words.zh: 不希望其他人在裡面時的狀態

words.definition: occurring at specific, determined periods of time
words.example: Periodic payments must be made on home loans.
words.zh: 發生在特定的、確定的時間段

words.example: Most liquids are prone to contract when frozen.
His prophetic powers were investigated by a team of psychologists.
words.zh: 正確地講述未來的事件

words.definition: the relationship of size or importance when compared to another object or person
words.example: The goal of establishing a space station will take a team effort of major proportions.
words.zh: 與另一個物體或人相比的大小或重要性的關係

words.example: The workers readily complained about the food in the cafeteria.
An appliance must perform its task reliably to be popular with consumers.
Although not completely satisfied with the contract, the officials reluctantly agreed to sign it.
This school is of great renown.

words.definition: to restore to life or bring back into memory
words.example: The students revived the old tradition of having a homecoming dance.

words.definition: to be full of something; crowded
words.example: The pond teemed with young fish in the warmer months.
